text:
I'm sorry the package arrived in that state. A cracked pot counts as damage on arrival, and since you're within the 48-hour reporting window (you're at about 20 hours), you're covered.

Please report it with photos of the damaged pot and the box. Once reported, you can choose a free replacement on the next plant shipping day, or a refund. Loose soil on its own is considered normal, but the cracked pot is what qualifies this.

If you'd like to keep the plant you have, I can't say from the policy whether a partial option exists, so I can escalate that to a Support Lead.
